title: In this town, every promise ties a knot over your head
description:
In my town, every promise you make ties a glowing knot over your head, and it stays there until you keep it. I've never made one. My dad has the oldest knot in town, grey and hard and ten years old, and this August it started pulling tight.

So I went back up the hill to his observatory for falling-star week, for the first time since he left. He wasn't alone up there.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: How many knots would be over your head right now?
